  # HTML Output
  html:

    code-copy: true       # Adds a one-click copy button to code blocks
    embed-resources: true # Bundles images/CSS into a single stand-alone HTML file
    df-print: paged       # Formats data frames into interactive paged tables
    fig-height: 5         # Default plot height in inches
    fig-width: 8          # Default plot width in inches
